stories.headline: Ciudad Juárez police free 15 migrants held for ransom in a string of September safe-house raids
stories.summary: Ciudad Juárez's municipal police carried out five separate rescues in the first two weeks of September, freeing 15 migrants whom smugglers had confined in residential safe houses…

stories.summary: A federal grand jury indicted Brian Matthew Griffeth, 48, of Tonto Basin, on September 9 on a charge of transporting a minor with intent to engage in criminal sexual activity…

stories.headline: Mississippi attorney general's office details its share of this month's 79-victim national sweep
stories.summary: The nationwide "Operation Coast to Coast" sweep reported earlier this month recovered 79 trafficking victims across 22 states in a single day of action on September 10.
